project: Steerable per-variable pure directions in Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct's dictator decision
direction: Steerable social-variable directions in LLM decision making (task.md; Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct dictator game over gender G, age A, instruction framing I, meeting condition M)

journey_summary.claim: given behavior (task.md) faithfully captured → 4 falsifiable sub-claims (C1 linear encoding, C2 purity, C3 bidirectional steering, C4 selectivity) mapped to milestones M1-M7
journey_summary.mechanism_routing: family=Representation and Parameter Analysis, submethod=Steering Vectors (CAA); composition = paired-prompt CAA extractor → GS/LEACE decorrelation → signed activation-addition → 4×4 selectivity + baselines
journey_summary.experiment: 7 dispatched runs (sanity + main + M4-supp L={12,16} + M7 portability), ~2.5 GPU-hours, headline mixed: C1 supported, C2 supported (GS) / failed (LEACE at shallow layers), C3 under-powered at picked shallow layers but supported at supp L=16 (M sign-inverts, A/G amplify, I bidirectional), C4 not supported at picked layers (V=G collapse); M7 portability negative (DeepSeek outputs τ=10 constant)
journey_summary.verify: 4 claim(s): 1 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 INCONCLUSIVE / 0 ZEV / 3 INTEGRITY_ONLY (cap=3, swap_off=0); integrity[Phase2=WARN / Phase9=WARN]
journey_summary.iteration: 2/6 iterations, claim-reentries=0/2, score 6/10 verdict almost, termination=positive_verdict; 4 back-edge dispatches (~0.9 GPU-h); C3 strengthened by n=10 random-direction null at ≥2.5σ direction-specificity; C1 LOPO stress test confirmed shallow-layer phrasing-confound suspicion for V=M (LOPO=0.483 = chance); C4 L=16 selectivity ran for the first time (p=0.128, borderline)

claims.statement: For each social/contextual variable V ∈ {G, A, I, M}, a linear direction v̂_V in the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct residual stream carries V's decision-relevant influence on the dictator-game transfer amount.

data.source: DG-1000 dictator-game trials + 4×1,000 paired-prompt partners (balanced 2×2×2×2 over G/A/I/M; token-length-matched)
data.used_n: 5000 (full; 800 train / 200 held-out baseline) + iteration LOPO stress on cached activations

claims.method: M2 — paired-prompt CAA difference-of-means direction v̂_V(layer); linear-probe cv_acc + projection-transfer OLS at picked ell_V*. Iteration ⓪ added Leave-One-Phrasing-Out cross-val at every layer as a lexical-confound stress test.

main_experiment.key_stats: probe cv_acc = 1.000 for all V; held_acc = 1.000; projection-transfer β at ell_V*: G=-10.12 (p=0.002), A=-4.85 (p=0.059 marginal), I=+32.10 (p=1.5e-9), M=+41.28 (p=3.5e-5)
main_experiment.headline: Linear encoding SUPPORTED at picked shallow layers ell_V* ∈ {2,4,6}. Iteration LOPO stress narrows the claim: V=M at ell_V*=2 LOPO=0.483 (chance-level — phrasing detector, NOT linear encoding of the variable). Best LOPO layers per V are in mid-band 10-14 for V=I/M and 28-32 for V=G/A.

claims.statement: A pure direction ṽ_V (raw v̂_V minus its overlap with the other three variables' directions) linearly predicts V without predicting the other variables — a cross-leakage matrix diagonal ≫ off-diagonal under a pre-registered threshold.

data.source: DG-1000 held-out activations cached from M2

claims.method: M3 — Gram-Schmidt + LEACE decorrelators; 4×4 cross-leakage probe matrix at ell_V*; predicates: diag mean ≥ 0.95× raw diag AND off-diag max ≤ chance+0.05 (0.55).

main_experiment.key_stats: GS: diag mean 0.958, off-diag max 0.506; LEACE: diag mean 0.573, off-diag max 0.829, ‖v̂_LEACE‖/‖v̂_raw‖ = 3.1-7.4
main_experiment.headline: Purity SUPPORTED under Gram-Schmidt (diag 0.958, off-diag 0.506) at picked shallow layers. LEACE fails at those layers because it erases the joint categorical of the other three variables together with the target — dataset-specific pathology at layers 2-6, not a claim falsification.

iteration.final_reviewer_status: almost — largest unresolved conceptual concern (P3): C3's causal steering uses raw v̂_V while C2 claims pure/decorrelated directions; the two are not empirically linked at L=16
iteration.narrowed_to: 'Pure directions free of confounds' should be narrowed to 'GS-decorrelated basis with off-diag 0.506 residual coupling' — a partially-decorrelated descriptive basis, not a strong disentanglement claim

claims.final_status: ⚠ configuration-specific & narrowed — GS variant supports a partial decorrelation at shallow layers; LEACE fails at these layers; C3 causal evidence used raw v̂_V so this claim is not empirically bridged to the causal result
caveats: LEACE fails at shallow picked layers — dataset-specific pathology

Reviewer's P3: C3's causal success at L=16 was demonstrated on raw v̂_V, not GS/LEACE-purified — so C2's purity claim is not empirically linked to the C3 causal claim; a future purity-intervention experiment at L=16 with GS directions is the natural closure

figures.caption: 4x4 cross-leakage probe accuracy matrix under GS vs LEACE decorrelators at Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct picked shallow layers ℓ_V*. Diagonal = target-self, off-diagonal = leakage. GS: diag mean 0.958 / off-diag max 0.506. LEACE: diag mean 0.573 / off-diag max 0.829.

claims.statement: Activation-addition h ← h + α ṽ_V at signed α ∈ [-4σ, +4σ] causally and monotonically shifts the mean transfer amount, with at least one α<0 inverting V's baseline sign (bidirectional causal steering with a dose-response + inversion audit and a coherence gate on generation quality).
claims.origin: task.md Claim §3 split part-a (bidirectional causal steering)

data.source: DG-1000 held-out × 4 V × signed-α grid; supplementary L={12,16} on raw v̂_V; verify variant on Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct at L={0,10,16}; iteration L=16 random-direction null (n=3 initial → n=10 extended)
data.used_n: 56000 decode ops main + supp L={12,16} + verify variant compact n=10/cell + iteration random-null 4 V × 5 α × 10 seeds at L=16
data.subset_note: sites re-bound single (window3 descoped Phase 1.5); L=16 supp compensates for ell_V* under-power; iteration added the missing L=16 random-direction control

claims.method: M4 — Signed CAA activation-addition on ṽ_V at ell_V* + L={12,16} supp; verify variant: same on Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct L={0,10,16}. Iteration ② added the L=16 random-direction control (10 seeds/setting) making direction-specificity σ-quantifiable.

main_experiment.verdict: partial at ell_V* [provisional — layer-pick under-power]; SUPPORTED at L=16 across two models + strengthened by n=10 random null at ≥2.5σ direction-specificity
main_experiment.key_stats: Main L=16 (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct): V=M inverts (+0.71→−0.31 at α=+2σ), V=A amplifies 5.5× (+0.11→+0.58), V=G amplifies 2.5× at α=−2σ, V=I bidirectional (+46%/−22%). Verify variant (Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct L=16): V=M sign-inverts at α=+2 (matches main); V=G/A/I bidirectional. Iteration random-null at L=16 (n=10 seeds): V=M α=+2 inversion at 2.84σ direction-specificity (0/10 random seeds inverted); V=A α=+2 at 2.69σ, V=G α=−2 at 4.30σ, V=I α=−2 at 2.50σ — all four effects direction-specific.
main_experiment.headline: Sign-asymmetric direction-specific causal steering at L=16 SUPPORTED across two models with a proper random-direction null control (≥2.5σ direction-specificity for all four showcase effects); V=M cleanly sign-inverts at α=+2σ. Under-powered at the max-probe-cv_acc-picked shallow layers ell_V* — a layer-pick heuristic issue, not a data/seed/grid shortfall.

claims.statement: Steering ṽ_V leaves the other three variables' effects on the transfer decision intact — a 4×4 selectivity matrix M[V, W] has diagonal effect-magnitude significantly larger than off-diagonal (permutation test rejects diagonal = off-diagonal).
claims.origin: task.md Claim §3 split part-b (selectivity), Claim §4 support (targeted intervention)

data.source: DG-1000 held-out reused across 4×4 steer-V/measure-W cells at α ∈ {-2,0,+2}σ at ell_V*; iteration added L=16 4×4 sweep
data.used_n: 12000 decode ops (main 12 grid points × 1000) + iteration L=16 12 grid points

claims.method: M5 — 4×4 selectivity matrix M[V,W] at ell_V*, LEACE-pure, single-site; predicates: diag ≫ off-diag AND permutation-test p<0.05. Iteration ② added the L=16 4×4 selectivity sweep that was originally deferred.

main_experiment.verdict: not-supported at ell_V* [provisional — layer-pick under-power]; partially selective at L=16 with substantial collateral coupling
main_experiment.key_stats: At ell_V*: max |off-diagonal|=0.455, min |diagonal|=0.000 (V=G at α=+2σ_proj=0.076), c4_ratio=∞, permutation p=0.84 (H0 not rejected). At L=16 (iteration): permutation p=0.128 (order-of-magnitude improvement, still not sig with n=4 V); per-V diag/mean-off ratio at α=+2σ: V=A 2.25, V=M 2.19 (both selective); V=I 1.00 (non-selective — co-modulates other Ws); V=G 0.00 at +σ (works at −σ with diag=−0.570).
main_experiment.headline: Selectivity NOT SUPPORTED at shallow ell_V* (V=G collapse). At L=16 selectivity is PARTIAL (permutation p=0.128, not stat-sig with n=4 V): V=A and V=M steering is genuinely selective (diag/off-diag ratio ~2.2); V=I steering is non-selective (ratio 1.00 — co-modulates other Ws); V=G steering fails at +σ. Substantial collateral coupling.

iteration.final_reviewer_status: INTEGRITY_ONLY (unchanged) — iteration ② added the L=16 4×4 selectivity sweep that improves p from 0.84 (shallow) to 0.128 (L=16) but reveals partial selectivity with substantial collateral coupling
